## Wave 1 Summary

Wave 1 makes the §EVOI.BF **CMB-orthogonal forward-EVOI axis** actionable — the weight-free falsifiers on the ANCHORED side of the §VII.BS NNU partition (`O = M_KK · Ô`, STAGE-3-PERMANENT, rank-1 `second_rel_sv=1.066e-17`). The S113 OBSAXIS workshop (`ws-s113-6-obsaxis-verdict.md`) ranked the two non-CMB falsifier axes and converged (both participants) on the M_KK dimensionful/dimensionless fork: f·σ8 growth is `Ô`-type (weight-free, pinned, once-passed — the #1 non-CMB falsifier); the NICER dense-matter M_max/compactness falsifier is `O`-type (M_KK-weighted, a free dial). This wave (1) FILLS the σ-distance on the chosen growth gate against the decisive instrument (Euclid 7-bin RSD), and (2) SCOPES whether the dense-matter axis survives at all in a weight-free re-cast (the W2-1 SIGN-PASS `dΔ_CFL/dμ>0` tied to FRIB symmetry-energy L), the constructibility check that resolves the workshop's residual dissent (Reading A #2-ranked, not closed).

Both gates are **COMPUTE-class** (M1 fails — they carry numerical/structural thresholds, not artifact-existence predicates; no `methodology-wave-allowlist.md` append owed). Gate 1 is a fully-pinned numerical χ² gate; Gate 2 is a constructibility SCOPE gate whose PASS/FAIL is the *existence* of a detector-reachable σ (a set-membership / two-branch adjudication outcome, per the R3 "NON-COMPUTE gate note (S95)" — PRDR items (2)(3)(4) are N/A with one-word reasons, the real PASS criterion is pinned in (1) operator + the verdict rubric).

## Wave 1 Decision Point Prerequisites

Neither Wave-1 gate consumes a within-S114 upstream verdict — both run from already-landed inputs (S96/S110 npz + INV13 npz + canonical_constants), so neither honestly-closes per `mechanical-closure-discipline.md` at dispatch. Upstream provenance (all on disk, SHA-pinned in the Input-SHA Ledger below):

- **Gate 1 (`CF-S113-FSIGMA8-EUCLID-7BIN`)**: consumes the fetched DESI-Y5/Euclid RSD forecast covariance `computations/session-96/s96_obs_fsigma8_forecast.npz` (S96-OBS-FSIGMA8-FORECAST; re-confirmed S97-FSIGMA8-FORECAST-REFETCH PASS) + canonical `f_FW`, `sigma8_growth_a2`, `f_LCDM`, `fsigma8_product_suppression_FW_max_pct`. The S113 `INV13-W2-2-FSIGMA8-GROWTH-S8: PASS` already reproduced the σ-distance (`bind_Euclid_max=1.516` per-bin) from this covariance; this gate lifts that to the **joint 7-bin χ²** the workshop pre-registered (≈1.534σ). The falsifier-inventory Row #71 sub-row already landed S113 (Row #71.audit-S113-WS6) — this gate is the COMPUTE that fills the joint-χ² σ-distance.
- **Gate 2 (`CF-S114-CO-SIGNDISC-FRIB-L-SCOPE`)**: consumes the W2-1 SIGN-PASS scan `computations/investigation-13/inv13_w2_1_finite_mu_cfl_eos.npz` (`dDelta_dmu`, `sign_pass=True`, the dimensionless `eos_gap_ratio_Delta_over_mu` vs the M_KK-inherited `eos_B_eff_MeV_fm3_dimensionful_MKK_inherited`) + the self-consistent repair `computations/session-110/s110_cf_co1_eos.npz` (`ratio_plateau=0.102`, `C_max_pinned=2.26e-4`, `C_MAX_FLOOR=1e-3`) + canonical `M_KK`. The FRIB band `L ≈ 40–70 MeV` (Sorensen+ 2024 combined χEFT+HIC+NS) is an **external observational comparison anchor**, NOT a framework canonical (no `canonical_constants` L pin exists — per `substrate-first-canonical-sourcing.md §(i)` an external observational value is a methodological cross-check anchor, never a substrate-replacement; the gate's substrate-derived quantity is `dΔ_CFL/dμ`, mapped *against* the FRIB band). The watchlist row `S113-CO-SIGNDISC-FRIB-L-WATCH` already landed S113.

```yaml
substitution_chain:

  content: |
    Claim: "The framework f·σ8(z) curve is SUPPRESSED below the LCDM reference at every Euclid z-bin,
            and its joint 7-bin σ-distance from the Euclid RSD forecast is BELOW the 3σ decisive
            threshold (≈1.534σ pinned)."

    Step 1 (Definitions, all from canonical_constants.py):
      f_FW(0)           = 0.5254916357116971   [canonical f_FW; a_2-growth-channel dlnD/dlna at z=0]
      f_LCDM(0)         = 0.5271303865722888   [canonical f_LCDM; standard growth dlnD/dlna at z=0]
      sigma8_growth_a2  = 0.79317              [canonical; a_2-growth-channel sigma_8 readout — NOT O-Z 0.799]
      sigma8_LCDM_ref   = 0.811                [Planck 2018 LCDM reference, S96-OBS-ANCHOR-HYGIENE]
      fsigma8_product_suppression_FW_max_pct = -4.058  [canonical; (fs8_FW - fs8_LCDM)/fs8_LCDM peak @ z=0.51]

    Step 2 (Test quantity, definition — no simplification):
      fs8_FW(z)   = f_FW(z) · sigma8_FW(z),   sigma8_FW(z)   = sigma8_growth_a2 · D_FW(z)/D_FW(0)
      fs8_LCDM(z) = f_LCDM(z) · sigma8_LCDM(z), sigma8_LCDM(z) = sigma8_LCDM_ref · D_LCDM(z)/D_LCDM(0)

    Step 3 (Substitute the z=0 amplitudes to read the suppression direction):
      sigma8_FW(0)/sigma8_LCDM(0) = 0.79317 / 0.811 = 0.97802  (< 1, FW amplitude lower)
      f_FW(0)/f_LCDM(0)           = 0.5254916357 / 0.5271303866 = 0.99689  (< 1, FW growth-rate lower)

    Step 4 (Simplify to the product ratio at z=0, one factor at a time):
      fs8_FW(0)/fs8_LCDM(0) = [f_FW(0)/f_LCDM(0)] · [sigma8_FW(0)/sigma8_LCDM(0)]
                            = 0.99689 · 0.97802
                            = 0.97499
      ⇒ product deviation at z=0 = (0.97499 - 1) = -2.501%   (both factors < 1 ⇒ product < 1)
      The full-z product suppression deepens to its -4.058% peak @ z=0.51 (canonical pin) because the
      growth-factor ratio D_FW(z)/D_LCDM(z) diverges further below unity off z=0.

    Step 5 (Direction read-off):
      Both [f_FW/f_LCDM < 1] AND [sigma8_FW/sigma8_LCDM < 1] ⇒ fs8_FW(z) < fs8_LCDM(z) at EVERY z
      ⇒ the residual r_i = fs8_FW(z_i) - fs8_LCDM(z_i) is NEGATIVE in every Euclid bin
      ⇒ sign_verdict = PASS iff the computed 7-bin (and 16-bin DESI cross-check) residual vector is
        sign-negative throughout (matches the suppression prediction).

    Step 6 (Magnitude / σ-distance):
      sigma_joint = sqrt( r^T C^{-1} r ),  C = fetched Euclid 7-bin RSD forecast covariance
      Pre-registered forecast value ≈ 1.534σ (Row #71); in-cache per-bin reproduction bind_Euclid_max
      = 1.516 (INV13-W2-2). magnitude_verdict: PASS iff sigma_joint <= 3.0σ decisive boundary.

    Conclusion: PASS = curve sign-suppressed in all bins AND sigma_joint <= 3.0σ (the 0-parameter
    suppressed a_2-growth prediction survives on the decisive Euclid instrument); FAIL = sigma_joint
    >= 3.0σ (the a_2-growth channel is excluded). Anti-rescue fence enforced: sigma8_growth_a2=0.79317
    USED (NOT O-Z 0.799), the -4.058% PRODUCT is the test quantity (NOT bare-f -0.311%), zero
    branch/scheme freedom.

PASS_meaning: >
  The 0-parameter f·σ8(z) curve is sign-suppressed in every Euclid bin AND its joint 7-bin σ-distance
  is below the 3σ decisive threshold (≈1.534σ as forecast). The framework's #1 non-CMB falsifier
  SURVIVES on the decisive Euclid instrument — a zero-free-parameter confirmation on a dataset not
  built for it (independent-confirmation gold; the §EVOI.BF UP-side LSS handle). Solution-space: the
  a_2 Seeley-DeWitt growth channel remains viable; the suppressed-growth prediction is corroborated.
FAIL_meaning: >
  sigma_joint >= 3.0σ: the suppressed FW curve is excluded by the Euclid RSD forecast at the decisive
  threshold. Solution-space: the a_2-growth channel is REFUTED — a measured f·σ8 above the suppressed
  value at decisive σ cleanly closes the growth-channel corridor (the framework's only non-CMB
  falsifier surface on the anchored side of the NNU partition would be eliminated).
INFO_meaning: >
  Intermediate: 1σ < sigma_joint < 3σ (the marginal/suggestive regime — consistent with the forecast
  ≈1.534σ but not yet decisive), OR a sign-vector partial (some bins not suppressed, flagging a curve
  reproduction or covariance-binning issue). The σ-distance is recorded; the corridor stays open
  pending the actual Euclid DR1 RSD release.
```

```yaml

(Borderline PARTICLE/NON-PHONONIC; the FRIB-L mapping leg is methodological — see substrate_framing.)

method:

    SCOPE-class constructibility check (NOT the full discriminant build). Three sub-steps:

            PASS is a genuine substrate falsifier and NOT an ansatz-forced free-dial PASS; and the
            FRIB-L map either exists with σ_reach>0 (CONSTRUCTIBLE) or does not (structural no-go)."

    Step 1 (NNU partition, §VII.BS, STAGE-3-PERMANENT):
      Every dimensionful substrate observable O factors as O = M_KK · Ô, M_KK the single permanently
      unanchored weight (rank-1, second_rel_sv=1.066e-17). ⇒ ANY headline observable that carries a
      mass/density dimension (M_max in M_⊙, compactness C, B_eff in MeV/fm^3) RIDES the M_KK free dial.

    Step 2 (Partition the W2-1 npz contents):

        eos_B_eff_MeV_fm3_dimensionful_MKK_inherited, M_max_Msun, eps_c_grid, eos_eps_cond_MKK4

        dDelta_dmu (sign + shape), sign_pass(=True), frac_increasing, eos_gap_ratio_Delta_over_mu,
        ratio_plateau (=0.102, from S110-CO1 self-consistent repair)

    Step 3 (Substitute: which side does the candidate discriminant live on?):
      The proposed discriminant g = sign/shape of dDelta_CFL/dmu (a density-derivative of the diquark
      gap). dDelta/dmu is [Δ]/[μ] = dimensionless (both Δ and μ in M_KK units ⇒ ratio M_KK-free).
      ⇒ g is on the DIMENSIONLESS side ⇒ g is Ô-type ⇒ a g-vs-FRIB-L comparison does NOT ride M_KK.

    Step 4 (Map direction to L):
      L = 3 n_0 (dS/dn)|_{n_0}  [symmetry-energy slope, a density-derivative of the symmetry energy].
      The substrate analog is the density-derivative-of-the-condensate sign dΔ_CFL/dμ > 0 (W2-1
      SIGN-PASS): a stiffening CFL gap at supra-saturation. The map g -> L is admissible ONLY if it
      uses the dimensionless stiffening-sign/shape and NOT a dimensionful density anchor. Whether the
      mapped L-band overlaps-and-is-distinguishable inside FRIB [40,70] MeV with σ_reach>0 is the
      CONSTRUCTIBILITY question this gate answers.

    Step 5 (Direction / branch read-off):
      PASS (CONSTRUCTIBLE): the dimensionless g maps to an L-band with σ_reach > 0.5 inside FRIB
        ⇒ the #2 dense-matter axis is a legitimate weight-free falsifier (sits on the ANCHORED side
        of the NNU partition, like the W2-1 SIGN-PASS itself).
      FAIL (STRUCTURAL NO-GO): every M_KK-free route is degenerate inside the band (σ_reach -> 0) OR
        the only discriminant with σ-reach is dimensionful (rides M_KK) ⇒ the dense-matter axis is
        Track-B intrinsic-dilute, M_KK-weighted all the way down (corroborated by C_max=2.26e-4 sub-floor
        after the S110-CO1 gap-repair, and S110-CF-CO2-FALSIFIER FAIL blocked by WS-CO-1 STERILE)
        ⇒ the growth axis (Gate 1) is the SOLE non-CMB falsifier.

    Conclusion: the gate is anti-rescue-fenced by construction (Step 3: discriminant is provably
    dimensionless ⇒ no free-dial PASS is possible); the verdict is the CONSTRUCTIBILITY branch
    (PASS=σ_reach>0 exists / FAIL=structural no-go / INFO=partial). NO M_max-in-M_⊙, NO compactness-vs-NICER.

PASS_meaning: >
  CONSTRUCTIBLE — a weight-free dimensionless discriminant (built from dΔ_CFL/dμ>0, the W2-1 SIGN-PASS)
  maps to the FRIB symmetry-energy slope L with a detector-reachable σ (σ_reach > 0.5 inside the
  [40,70] MeV band), AND the map is provably M_KK-free (Ô-type). Solution-space: the #2 dense-matter
  axis is a LEGITIMATE non-CMB falsifier on the anchored side of the NNU partition — a terrestrial-anchored,
  FRIB-cross-checked falsifier the growth axis structurally lacks. Funds the full discriminant build
  (the ~2-3-wave construction) as the higher-LEVERAGE second falsifier. Routes to the watchlist
  promotion (mack) + Row #88 annotation.
FAIL_meaning: >
  STRUCTURAL NO-GO — no M_KK-free dimensionless route maps to FRIB L with resolvable σ (every weight-free
  discriminant is degenerate inside the band, σ_reach -> 0, OR the only σ-reach discriminant rides M_KK).
  Solution-space: the dense-matter axis is Track-B intrinsic-dilute, M_KK-weighted all the way down
  (corroborated by C_max=2.26e-4 sub-floor post-repair + S110-CF-CO2-FALSIFIER FAIL / WS-CO-1 STERILE)
  ⇒ the framework's non-CMB falsifier surface is the GROWTH AXIS ALONE (Gate 1). This is decisive
  constraint-map information: it closes the dense-matter falsifier corridor and confirms the §EVOI.BF
  axis is single (growth). Routes to the Row #88 "structural-no-go" annotation (mack).
INFO_meaning: >
  PARTIAL — the dimensionless map exists but its σ_reach is regime-conditional or partial (e.g. resolvable
  only at the band edge, or only under a specific CFL-onset μ_eff sub-choice). The constructibility
  question is not cleanly resolved; the dense-matter axis is neither confirmed-constructible nor a clean
  no-go. Routes to a full-construction CF (the ~2-3-wave discriminant build) to settle σ-reach, with the
  watchlist held constructibility-pending.
```

## Wave 1 → Wave 2 Decision Point

Wave 2 (the τ_fold / K-pivot / CC-residual structural gates) does NOT consume Wave-1 outputs — the waves are structurally orthogonal (observational frontier vs internal-structure constants). No branching dependency. The Wave-1 verdicts route to falsifier-surface writes (mack sole writer), NOT to a Wave-2 gate input:

- **Gate 1 PASS** → falsifier-inventory Row #71 joint-χ² σ-distance sub-row landed (the #1 non-CMB falsifier sharpened on the decisive instrument); §EVOI.BF UP-side LSS handle confirmed; §7.1 capstone falsifier-anchor surface (growth row) reconciled (capstone-hygiene Q2: route the §7.1/§7.2 update to mack). **Gate 1 FAIL** → Row #71 down-tag + capstone §7.1 growth-row status reconciliation (the a_2-growth channel corridor closes) — a Q3 capstone-hygiene reconciliation routed to mack.
- **Gate 2 PASS** → watchlist `S113-CO-SIGNDISC-FRIB-L-WATCH` promoted to constructibility-CONFIRMED; Row #88 annotated "weight-free FRIB-L discriminant CONSTRUCTIBLE"; a full-discriminant-build CF queued (~2-3 waves) as the higher-leverage second falsifier. **Gate 2 FAIL** → Row #88 annotated "dense-matter axis STRUCTURAL NO-GO (Track-B intrinsic-dilute, M_KK-weighted)"; the §EVOI.BF axis confirmed single (growth alone); watchlist row closed. **Gate 2 INFO** → full-construction CF queued; watchlist held constructibility-pending.

Both routes are mack-sole-writer inventory edits per `feedback_mack-bridge-role.md` + the canonical write-order (Step 3 inventory landing).
